coverage: Real OpenSSH password authentication and native rsync recover after the owned TCP transport is reset during protocol exchange.
Same download UUID, dataset, generation, scope, manifest digest and scoped environment/publication digest are retained; changed receipts cannot trigger another transfer.
Existing partial markers survive interruption and disappear only after successful transfer; final SHA-256 and download receipt checks pass.
Full/scoped recovery, corrective-transfer budget sharing, five failed handshakes, fifth-attempt success and BUSY resume replies are bounded.
Permissions, authentication, changed host keys, corrupted manifests, local I/O and intentional cancellation never trigger automatic recovery.
Replacement control environment is used for retries and finish; successful transfer statistics identify potentially missing interrupted-attempt traffic.
Existing real scoped protocol/rsync mirroring with deletion, native bracket-path correction and unchanged-content fast paths continue to pass.
